name: StopBloatingMe
author: Oddisz
description: Browse every ship, weapon, fighter, commodity and special item in your install from the main menu, and blacklist the ones you don't want. Blacklisted ships stop spawning in fleets and markets and are hidden from the codex; blacklisted weapons and fighters stop appearing in markets but still spawn on ships, so nothing breaks. Everything you block also stops dropping as loot -- salvage, battle debris, tech mining, caches and blueprints. Filter by size, designation, source mod and design type.
